The Utility
4
Utility is the WANT-SATISFYING PROPERTY of a COMMODITY from a COMMODITY ANGLE
Utility is the psychological feeling of satisfaction, pleasure, happiness or well-being which a consumer derives from the consumption, possession or the use of a commodity from a consumer angle
Utility is ‘subjective’ or ‘relative’ in nature

The slide text is an image. Heading Total Utility: TOTAL UTILITY may be defined as the sum of the utilities derived by a CONSUMER from the various units of GOODS & SERVICES he consumes. Formula: TU = U1 + U2 + U3 + ... + Un, where 1,2,3......,n is the good/services consumed. Heading Marginal Utility: Marginal utility refers to the CHANGE in the total utility obtained from the consumption of an ADDITIONAL UNIT of a COMMODITY. Formula: MU = ΔTU / ... = (TU_n - TU_(n-1)) / ...; the bottom line of both fractions is cut off at the bottom edge of the slide, so only the tops (ΔTU and TU_n - TU_(n-1)) can be read.

slides.text:
12
The Law of Diminishing Marginal Utility
The utility gained from successive units of a commodity diminishes. In other words, the marginal utility of a commodity diminishes as consumer acquires larger quantities of it.

bullets.text: The Law of Diminishing Marginal Utility

slides.visual_text: The slide text is an image. Heading: CONSUMER'S EQUILIBRIUM: Single commodity case. Below it the same Total Utility and Marginal Utility text as before: TOTAL UTILITY may be defined as the sum of the utilities derived by a CONSUMER from the various units of GOODS & SERVICES he consumes. TU = U1 + U2 + U3 + ... + Un, where 1,2,3......,n is the good/services consumed. Marginal utility refers to the CHANGE in the total utility obtained from the consumption of an ADDITIONAL UNIT of a COMMODITY. MU = ΔTU / ΔQuantity of good X = (TU_n - TU_(n-1)) / (Commodity_n - Commodity_(n-1)). No equilibrium condition is written on the slide.
